name: hpc-agent-antigravity
description: Standalone HPC Orchestrator Plugin: Cloud HPC Toolkit provisioning, VM availability & quota checks, Nextflow Batch optimization, and 2 interactive 30-day UI sidecars (HPC/Slurm/Storage Monitor & Google Cloud Batch Monitor).

Open the Google Cloud Batch Monitor sidecar and check which users and jobs have the longest runtime
Check VM availability and compute quotas for an H4D Slurm cluster in us-central1
